output_evals.prompt: Mam PKOBP 100, KGHM 30, CDPROJEKT 20, DINO 10, KETY 5 i 10 000 zł gotówki. Ile stracę w kryzysie? Mogę stracić najwyżej 20%.
assertions: scripts/gpw_risk_lab.py stress was executed with --positions, --cash 10000 and --max-loss-pct 20
The answer leads with a plain sentence of the form 'W scenariuszu 2008 Twój portfel straciłby ~X zł (−Y%)' using the script's numbers
Names the worst scenario and the positions that lose most in it
States which scenarios exceed the 20% limit, as numbers, without telling the user to sell anything
Explains that positions not listed in older crises were estimated with an index × beta proxy (method column)
Mentions liquidity under stress (days to exit)
Quotes the data session date

output_evals.prompt: How would I hedge my holdings.csv with WIG20 futures?
assertions: Uses hedge mode
Reports portfolio beta vs WIG20, contracts rounded down and the round-up alternative with hedge ratios
States the FW20 multiplier (20 PLN), the series used and its last trading day / roll date
Reports residual (non-WIG20) risk and explains futures cannot remove it
Presents the margin as an estimate and tells the user to check with their broker
Mentions PIT-38 treatment and that futures on IKE/IKZE are allowed only for risk reduction if the broker offers it
Answer is in English and contains no 'sell'/'short now' recommendation

output_evals.prompt: Mam akcje za 25 tys. zł. Jak je zabezpieczyć?
assertions: Runs hedge mode and reports that the portfolio is below one FW20 contract

Does not recommend buying the ETF, only presents it as an option
